title: Feature Learning for the High Dimensional Stationary Schödinger Equation with Deep Ritz Method
summary: This paper investigates feature learning within the framework of the deep Ritz method for solving the stationary Schrödinger equation with Neumann boundary conditions. We first analyze the convergence of Riemannian gradient descent in an agnostic setting, where the hypothesis function is restricted to a single-index model while the PDE solution is arbitrary. We prove that gradient descent reaches an approximate global minimum: after T = O(log(1/ε)) iterations, the loss is within εof a constant multiple of the optimal loss.
